response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile full-stack/systems engineer with strong experience in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile platforms, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no recent hands-on C++ on Windows (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments over a decade ago), no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure aside from a short stint at a fintech startup using JS/TS/GraphQL.
strengths: Long, diverse senior/staff-level engineering career with strong craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some prior C/C++ experience (National Instruments) and general SQL familiarity
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No current or recent C++ development experience (last substantial C/C++ work was 2014-2015)
No Windows platform development experience mentioned; recent work is cross-platform/cloud/web
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience; RIDE Capital role used JS/TS/GraphQL, not C++

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/relevant C++ Windows experience
No fixed income/capital markets domain expertise
Strong general engineering skill and communication ability
